# The mailbox protocol smoke test checks metadata and URI text without opening a channel

Removing the nsIMailboxUrl QI leaves a smoke test for protocol metadata and URI spec. The newChannel check is still commented out with a Windows-failure note, so this task does not exercise the protocol’s new concrete receiver access. The URI-spec assertion and the other four assertion sites also have no failure messages. A focused repair should add nonempty expected-behavior messages containing should; these omissions predate the interface cleanup. No test ran.

Scope: Mailbox protocol unit-test coverage and diagnostics.

[Lesson record](../records/e3caff870913d5117a540cbbb0a838719528f369f3602d977c5085aa0c4019db.json).
